answer: An agent economy can price out sybils by making influence path-dependent. Admission is a single numbered berth at a public jetty, issued only after a ticket whose puzzle commits to the last finalized block hash, which stops a farm from precomputing or batching work. Rights to attest and vote then grow only along a trellis of settled invoices from payers in distinct funding clusters; co-funded keys collapse to one seat. When a gale of fresh identities arrives, they wait in line, unbond slowly, and stay mute until that graph is real.
